outputs: normalized subtitles, metadata or temporary authorized audio

explicitly authorized non-YouTube audio normalization is needed

tools.trigger_when: authorized non-YouTube audio has no usable subtitles and both audio fallback gates are true
authorized whisper.cpp audio fallback is enabled

boundaries: Only public HTTP(S) sources; no login, cookie, credential, DRM, paywall, CAPTCHA or age-control bypass.
Public YouTube is captions-and-metadata only; audio/video download and Whisper fallback are blocked even when audio fallback is otherwise requested.
YouTube channel roots are enumerated across public videos, Shorts and stream archives and deduplicated by video ID; playlists are enumerated as one collection.

Shared cloud IPs can receive upstream YouTube LOGIN_REQUIRED/bot challenges before captions are exposed; caption access failures are reported separately from confirmed missing captions and never bypassed with hidden cookies, proxy, account or external transcript fallback.
Non-YouTube Whisper fallback requires allow_audio_fallback=true, audio_access_authorized=true and a concrete authorization/rights_basis.
The official yt-dlp Unix binary bundles EJS scripts; pinned local Deno is used for the JavaScript runtime and remote EJS component downloads are not enabled.
Raw source content is never automatically project truth or automatically written to a Skill.
Content is persisted only when reuse_allowed=true and usable extracted content exists; provenance, metadata and hashes may persist without content.
Audio media and model files are temporary runtime inputs and are never committed to Git.
All output is at most controlled_runtime evidence and remains subject to Webactueel-workflow source quality, rights, deduplication, currentness and controlled-write gates.
